name: Kathmandu Valley Heritage Tour
alt_names: Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Sites Tour
Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur heritage tour
sub_region: Kathmandu, Lalitpur and Bhaktapur districts, Bagmati Province

difficulty.notes: City sightseeing on foot and by private vehicle; Swayambhunath involves a long stair climb if approached from the east side.

duration_days.basis: sightseeing days in Kathmandu Valley (hotel to hotel)
duration_days.notes: The seven UNESCO monument zones can be covered in 2 full days; a 1-day version usually covers Kathmandu Durbar Square, Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath and Boudhanath; a 3rd day allows Bhaktapur + Changu Narayan at a slower pace or a Nagarkot sunrise add-on.

itinerary.route: Kathmandu Durbar Square (Hanuman Dhoka) - Swayambhunath - Pashupatinath - Boudhanath
itinerary.notes: Pashupatinath main temple is Hindu-only; non-Hindus view the riverside ghats and cremation platforms from the east bank.

itinerary.route: Patan Durbar Square (incl. Patan Museum) - Bhaktapur old city & Durbar Square - Changu Narayan
itinerary.notes: Bhaktapur ticket covers the whole walled old city, not only Durbar Square.

best_seasons.notes: Year-round activity. Monsoon (Jun-Sep) brings afternoon rain but sites remain open. Festival dates (e.g. Dashain, Tihar, Indra Jatra, Bisket Jatra) add colour but crowds. Seasonal notes are general guidance, not from a single authority.

permits.applies_to: foreign nationals (non-SAARC); SAARC/BIMSTEC NPR 500; under 10 free

Bhaktapur (Cultural City) tourist entry fee
permits.fee: USD 15 or NPR 2,000 per person (Bhaktapur Municipality, from 17 July 2025); NTB page still lists USD 18 / NPR 1,800
permits.applies_to: non-SAARC foreign nationals; SAARC and Chinese NPR 500; validity extendable up to 7 days on request

permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; SAARC NPR 50; under 10 free

permits.name: Boudhanath (Boudha Stupa) entry
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; SAARC NPR 100; under 10 free

permits.name: Pashupatinath Temple area entry
permits.fee: NPR 1,000 per person per day per entry
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; SAARC NPR 1,000; Indian nationals free

guide_requirements: No legal requirement for a licensed guide at Kathmandu Valley heritage sites. OutdoorKing would use licensed city guides as a service choice.

drives: Private vehicle between monument zones within the valley
logistics.notes: Tickets are bought separately at each site; there is no combined pass. Keep tickets while inside each zone (Bhaktapur checks at multiple lane booths).

highlights: Seven monument zones inscribed together as the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Site (1979): Hanuman Dhoka (Kathmandu), Patan and Bhaktapur Durbar Squares, Swayambhu, Bauddhanath, Pashupati and Changu Narayan
Swayambhu includes the oldest Buddhist stupa in the valley; Bauddhanath is the largest stupa in Nepal
Changu Narayan has one of the earliest inscriptions in the valley (5th century AD)
Newar tiered temples, carved wooden windows and palace courtyards
Evening aarti at Pashupatinath viewed from the east bank of the Bagmati
risks: Traffic and air pollution in Kathmandu
Some structures still under post-2015-earthquake restoration

Seasonal recommendations are general guidance, not from an official source.
